What it serves

per feature
  • Live transcriptyesstreams the live transcript and progress
  • Steeringyestakes steering messages (run.steer)
  • Recoveryyesrecovers a lost run (run.recover)
  • Sandbox shellnohas no sandbox shell: pi-dispatch sandbox cannot reopen its runs

These say what the venue can do, not what it guarantees, so no floor compares them. A feature can still be refused before spend when the job image lacks its capabilities.

When an observation does not hold

credentials stay on owned networks

the OpenShell gateway this worker's openshell CLI talks to listens on a loopback address or a unix socket on this host. Where this does not hold, the word drops to asserted and a floor asking for enforced refuses.

Run the OpenShell gateway on this host and register it on loopback (`openshell gateway add https://127.0.0.1:17670 --local`); a remote gateway is refused, not lowered.

openshell gateway add https://127.0.0.1:17670 --local
